headline: Callahan's Passage Erupts as Northern Battles Churn Across Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, fresh instability has broken out in Callahan's Passage, where four base exchanges at The Latch over the past two hours reignited fighting alongside surging casualties. Northern friction continues unabated in Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse, which recorded four and three base transitions respectively in the same two-hour window. Weathered Expanse remains the war's bloodiest theater, posting over twelve hundred combined casualties in two hours as combat sweeps through Shattered Advance and Wightwalk, while Stlican Shelf sees contested strongholds around Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost left in flux. Meanwhile, Linn of Mercy and Stonecradle sustain heavy, attritional exchanges with hundreds of casualties despite holding their lines without fresh base flips. Godcrofts logged minor shifts earlier in the morning before cooling, whereas Dead Lands, Marban Hollow, and Viper Pit show minimal new disruption following previous clashes. Secondary coastal waters and interior rear hexes remain entirely quiet.
